description: Save a screenshot as a session artifact and return its swipium:// URI. Withheld on password/OTP screens unless force:true. Counts against the screenshot budget. inline:true also returns the image (JPEG, long edge 1568 px, scale in the text) for clients that can see images.

inline.description: Also return the image inline (the result then has no structuredContent).

name: qa_screenshot
title: Capture a screenshot
